A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ProgCo study. Text, equations, tables, figures and appendices support reliable comparison, including material relocated from Appendix D into the main text.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations on IFEval, GSM8K and MATH, including benchmark comparisons, component ablations, tool integration and self-consistency experiments.

after.justification: v2 reports original benchmark evaluations, ablations, tool-integration results and self-consistency comparisons in Tables 1–4 and Figures 4–5.

M1.justification: ProgVe generation and execution, ProgRe reflection and regeneration, and verification-program refinement remain unchanged. Equations, Algorithm 1 and appendix prompts match. Optional Python integration already appears in v1.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate instruction following on IFEval and mathematical reasoning on GSM8K and MATH. The same case-study inputs remain; relocating their discussion adds no task or scenario coverage.

E2.justification: The main baselines, Figure 4 verifier comparisons, and SC-Vote, SC-Reflex and SC-Select comparators are retained. Table 4 supplies another score for an existing comparator without changing the comparator set.

E3.justification: Model configurations, the 500-instance MATH subset, metrics, correction budgets and self-consistency settings remain unchanged. The statement about independently scoring each correction round moves from Appendix C.3 to Section 3.1; it is not a new protocol.

E4.justification: The tool-integration analysis, verification recall/F1 comparison, refinement ablations, iteration analysis and case studies are retained. Appendix D.2's case-study discussion moves to Section 3.7 without new examples or findings.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. Point-score reporting and average refinement-turn reporting remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 4 replaces the dash for SC-Select with ten samples on IFEval(Pr) with 56.19. Other tabulated values and plotted results match. Section 3.2 also introduces a reporting error: the existing 3.47-point IFEval(Ins) gain is labeled IFEval(Pr), contradicting Table 1.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(5), Algorithm 1 and mathematical reasoning in the appendix prompts remain unchanged. Neither version contains added or revised theoretical propositions or proofs.

C1.justification: Both versions claim effective self-correction through ProgVe and ProgRe, superior performance across the three benchmarks, and benefits from integrating Python tools. The added introductory roadmap restates existing claims.

C2.justification: Section 3.4 newly attributes Python-assisted IFEval improvements to more precise feedback on word-count and keyword constraints. Existing interpretations and limitations concerning application scope, numerical accuracy and inference costs remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-release statement and project-repository link in the abstract. The appendix prompt templates, pseudocode, model identifiers, inference settings and evaluation implementation details otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and Appendix A's research positioning remain unchanged, including distinctions from PAL, POT, ToRA and earlier self-correction approaches.

P1.justification: v2 adds a brief introductory roadmap, separates experimental analyses into numbered subsections, and moves Appendix D.1–D.2 into Sections 3.6–3.7. These organizational edits retain almost all existing prose.

P2.justification: All four tables and fourteen figures remain. Table 4 moves into the main text, Tables 2 and 3 exchange order and numbering, and existing visuals are repositioned. Figure 1's caption and pagination change, while the diagrams, plots and appendix examples retain their content.

improvement.justification: v2 improves reporting modestly by providing a code-access link, completing a missing baseline result and making existing comparisons more visible in the main text. The method and supporting evidence remain essentially unchanged. The new metric-label typo in Section 3.2 is a limited regression, but does not outweigh these small gains in accessibility and completeness.
